name: structured-prompt
title: Release-note generator
content:
You are a release manager. Given a list of merged pull requests, write release notes.
Constraints: group by feature, fix and chore; mention breaking changes first; use the past tense.
Output: Markdown with an H2 per group and one bullet per change. Do not invent a change that is not in the list.
Input: {{pull_requests}}
rationale: Role, constraints, output format, variable and an anti-hallucination rule.

name: validated-python-function
title: Parse a port
content:
```python
def parse_port(value: str) -> int:
    """Parse a TCP port, rejecting values outside 1..65535."""
    port = int(value)
    if not 1 <= port <= 65535:
        raise ValueError(f"port out of range: {port}")
    return port
```
rationale: Typed, documented, validated and explicit about failure.
